pages.text: $(item)Item$(), $(item)Fluid$() and $(item)Energy$() pipes connect to pipes of the same type and to any block that exposes the matching capability.$(br2)The $(item)Universal Pipe$() moves items, fluids and energy at once; each side can switch its channels on and off.
Four pipes per craft: iron and gold around redstone and what the pipe carries.
The $(item)Chemical Pipe$() needs Mekanism and moves gases, infuse types, pigments and slurries.$(br2)Pipes can be waterlogged, and items they move are drawn travelling through the pipe walls.
